decisions.name: go-api-contracts
decisions.reason: The supported external CLI/file/process contract changes from one record to an ordered batch; preserve single-record bytes, arguments, exit statuses, streams, and accepted-prefix semantics.

decisions.name: go-behavior-tests
decisions.reason: Meaningful batch behavior and requested success/failure tests require independent persisted-file assertions, retained prefixes, rejected/later effects, actual executable outcomes, and a genuine partial-write duplicate failure.

decisions.name: go-core-style
decisions.reason: Writing Go implementation and tests; retain standard-library dependencies, Go 1.22-compatible APIs, direct error handling, and formatting.

decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
decisions.reason: Atomic record publication introduces owned temporary-file lifetime and cleanup. Use concrete os.File operations rather than a mock-only storage interface.

decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
decisions.reason: The existing main package keeps its CLI parsing and filesystem responsibility; no package creation, relocation, or import-direction change.
